fields.description: Test Mode is decided by which key pair you paste in: Razorpay test keys start with rzp_test_. This flag only records which pair is in use.
fields.label: Test Mode

fields.description: Razorpay can authorise a payment without capturing it. Only turn this on if your Razorpay account captures automatically — on a manual-capture account it would release goods against funds that were never captured.
fields.label: Treat Authorised As Paid

fields.description: Lets Razorpay SMS and email the payment link to the shopper, and chase them if they do not pay. Off by default: the shopper is already on the payment page, and each message is billable.
fields.label: Send Razorpay Notifications To Shopper

fields.description: Fallback currency when the payment request does not carry one.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: Optional, and different from the Key Secret. Until it is set, webhook deliveries are rejected and payment status is only picked up by polling.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: A Payment Link carries only one callback, so Razorpay never redirects here; it is the URL the storefront uses when a payment fails.
fields.label: Failure URL

fields.description: A Payment Link carries only one callback, so Razorpay never redirects here; it is the URL the storefront uses when a shopper abandons checkout.
fields.label: Cancelled URL
